import sys

import parse

# Test various edge cases for integer parsing
tests = [
    ('{name:d}', '42'),
    ('{name:d}', '0x1a'),
    ('{name:d}', '0b101'),
    ('{name:d}', '0o75'),
    ('{name:x}', 'FF'),  # hex without prefix
    ('{name:b}', '1010'),  # binary without prefix
    ('{name:o}', '77'),  # octal without prefix
]

for fmt, s in tests:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
    print(f'{fmt!r} on {s!r}: {r.named if r else None}')
" 2>&1
